item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
Welcome to StockDeck 1.0

  • Full-Featured Stock & Portfolio Deck: Track stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, and crypto with realtime price updates and comprehensive portfolio analytics.
  • Responsive Positions Table: Dynamic positions card with full-width responsive layout matching screen width.
  • Native Currency Precision: Cost basis, Average Cost, Market Value, and Position P&L strictly preserve each asset's native currency symbol (₫, $, ¥, €).
  • Automatic Weight Sorting: Portfolio positions automatically sort by weight/market value descending. Newly added assets auto-sort instantly.
  • Performance & Benchmarks: Money-weighted return (XIRR) tracking and period change performance vs S&P 500 benchmark.
